◀ LEFT0%RIGHT ▶
Move the sticks and press buttons — the highlighted axis is the one bound above. In Total Control mode, hold your swerve on the right stick and press A to swing: the tester reads the shot back — flight curve, spin, total bend and drift at goal range.

retry a Skill Trial
The triggers are one axis — LT finesse ◀ ▶ RT power — and holding both cancels back to a normal swing. A charge has a sweet band: the marker over your rod swells gold and the charge tick brightens when you are in it. Hold past it and the rod trembles, the shot loses power and it sprays.
In Total Control the same two triggers ALSO size the slide step — LT fine, RT fast — and the right stick becomes the swing: pull back and flick forward. Hold both triggers with the stick pulled back to charge that swing, and the free right-stick axis bends the shot.

Mouse & Keyboard

These sliders scale how fast the mouse and the slide keys move a rod; which keys do what is under Key Bindings. Locking the cursor hides it and lets the mouse keep going past the edge of the screen — ESC releases it and pauses.

Key Bindings

Press +, then a key, a mouse button or the wheel. Click a key to remove it. ESC cancels. A key already doing something else moves to the new action.
Ctrl+W, Ctrl+T and Ctrl+N close or open browser tabs and a web page can't stop them. With finesse on a Ctrl key, slide on the arrows rather than W / S when playing in a browser.
